lines: Chaotic voltage source simulating a multi-segment pendulum, running the same code as the Vult hardware module, with eight simulation models and eight interrelated outputs

Sets a new initial position and new angular velocities, and pressed repeatedly it can make the pendulum rotate continuously
Reverses the angular velocities, so every segment moves the opposite way
Saves the current state of the pendulum
Returns the pendulum to the saved state
A trigger that sets a new initial position and new angular velocities
A trigger that reverses the angular velocities
A trigger that saves the current state of the pendulum
A trigger that returns the pendulum to the saved state

A clock that samples and holds the four Y outputs, which turns the continuous movement into stepped voltages
A control voltage added to the energy, scaled by the ENERGY attenuverter

The vertical position of that segment of the pendulum
Menu — MODE — picks the simulation model directly: Pendula, Planets, Fish Tank, Fluctuating Voltage, Coupled Oscillators, Feedback Dynamics, Analog Shift Register or Kicked Rotors
Caudal-HW.notes: The maker's tooltip for output 2 reads X-B, the same as output 1; the panel prints A, B, C, D across the row, so output 2 is the C column. The line describes the jack without naming its letter. The four lamps over the MODE button show which of the eight models is selected and are not parameters. The menu item is printed MODE here and Model on the full-size Caudal in VultModulesFree — not a mistake in either entry: the Compacts binary contains no string "Model" at all, while the full-size one has it sitting immediately before the Pendula, Planets and Fish Tank choices in the literal pool. Do not reconcile the two.

Vraids.notes: The documentation site has no page of controls for Vraids, and the hardware product page says only that the firmware is based on the code by Emilie Gillet. The panel names, the maker's tooltips and the strings in the binary are the sources for every line here. The model names in the binary are SAW-SQR, SIN-TRI, SQR-SUB, SAW-SUB, 3X-SAW, 3X-SQR, 3X-TRI, 3X-SIN, 3X-RING, VOSIM, FEED-FM, PLUCK, BOWED, WAV-TBL, WAV-MAP, WAV-LIN, WAV-TX4 and CLOUD. What the AM/FM knob modulates is stated only by the panel label and the screen legend AM(VCA)/FM, so its line does not say which oscillator modulates which.
